title: 几个月的朝阳隼侧面就开裂了，需要换吗？
notes: Owner post (2026-04-16): H496 front and rear sidewalls cracked after a few hundred road kilometres (mostly indoor-trainer use over winter) at 95-100 psi. Commenters were split on whether surface cracks matter; one said a STORM R1 cracked within a month. Photos re-checked 2026-11-02: the cracked sidewall carries the moulded code H-496-06.
